_description: GENERATED by `python -m app.tools.build_audible_backfill` from a read-only audible-cli library export. Do not hand-edit: re-run the builder. Read by app/core/audible_backfill.py.
_what_it_does: Fills genre/year ONLY where a file's own tags carry Audible's container placeholders (genre 'Audiobook', year '2000' or a future year). Never overrides a real tag; scripts/catalog_overrides.json still wins over it.
_public_repo: Product facts only. No purchase dates, no account or profile names.
